metadata.title: Convex monohedral tilings: a sharp neighbor bound and rigidity in the equality case
metadata.abstract: We study both side-to-side and non-side-to-side convex monohedral tilings of the Euclidean plane in which every tile has the same number of neighbors. Reflections are allowed, point contacts count as neighbors, and no periodicity assumption is imposed. Combining boundary estimates for sums of face curvatures, angle-incidence counts and side-length matching, we prove that the common neighbor number satisfies $N\le21$ and classify all equality cases. Equality holds precisely when the prototile is a $30^\circ$-$30^\circ$-$120^\circ$ triangle and the entire tiling is similar to the central subdivision of the standard equilateral triangular tiling. This resolves the open problem on the maximum common number of neighbors recorded in Adams's The Tiling Book.

techniques: 面曲率总和的边界估计
analysis.breakthrough: 解决Adams书中关于最大公共邻居数的问题，等号刚性决定整个平面铺砌。
analysis.limitations: 需凸性、单一原型及每块邻居数相同，且点接触计数对常数和分类均关键。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
